response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced (15+ year) full-stack and systems engineer with strong software craftsmanship credentials, but he lacks the core AI/GenAI qualifications this role requires. His hands-on exposure to agentic workflows and MCP tooling only spans the last few months at re:cinq, far short of the 8+ years of AI-driven solution development required, and there is no evidence of Python usage, vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI in his history.
strengths: 15+ years of production software engineering across web, mobile, and embedded systems with staff-level titles
Current role includes direct work on MCP code generators and agentic-workflow tooling
Demonstrated mentoring, workshop facilitation, and technical leadership experience
concerns: No demonstrated 8+ years of AI-driven solution development; AI/agentic exposure is only ~4 months old
No evidence of Python proficiency, vector database usage, or RAG architecture design
No mention of major cloud platform AI system design (only brief AWS CDK use) or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI

key_factors.factor: Lack of substantive AI/GenAI production experience
No evidence of RAG, vector DB, or multi-agent framework expertise
Strong general engineering seniority and full-stack breadth
